kind: POST_FREEZE_INTERPRETATION_ONLY; NO SCORER OR PROTOCOL CHANGE
assumptions: Distinct intact labels, disjoint band inventories, planted ordering; independent within-band shuffle; all legal per-band rotations and reflections searched.
derivation: For a band of n distinct items, 2n of n! orders are dihedrally equivalent when n>=3. With independent bands the favorable fractions multiply. Every such null permutation attains a perfect score, so even the most extreme upper-tail p cannot be smaller than this fraction.
implication: Three bands of four have ideal null floor 1/27 = .037037, exceeding frozen alpha .01. Failure to detect on that geometry is expected from search equivalence alone, even without noise. This is an identifiability/power limit, not evidence of arithmetic or scorer corruption.
qualification_effect: Preserve the originally declared all-cell failure if it occurs; do not delete geometry, relax threshold or reduce searched freedoms.
